title: Start and-elim out of a chunked conjunction from its tail theorems
summary: An and-elimination step out of a conjunction of more than 256 operands now starts from the kernel-checked tail theorem of the operand's chunk instead of a chain of let bindings restated in every proof. The QF_IDL benchmark parity/10.700.graph, one assertion of 115,040 operands, now verifies in Lean, and parity/13.400.graph checks in 50 s instead of 264 s.
